video_title: I Toured Klay Thompson's 10 MILLION Dollar House!

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on the difficulty of recovering from his ACL and Achilles injuries
quotes.excerpt: Watching your teammates out there struggle without you is the worst feeling.
quotes.quote: That was difficult. Probably the most difficult time in my life because basketball for me is like breathing. I do it in my spare time just as much as I do it for a job. I was so lucky to have great teammates in Stephen Curry and Draymond Green and everybody on the team. I give a shout out to Kevin Durant all the time because he went through the same injury and it was really hard. Knowing how good you are and how much you affect the team, watching your teammates out there struggle without you is the worst feeling. By the grace of God, I am healthy again and I am just happy to still be doing it at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson recalls Kobe Bryant's early prediction of his future success
quotes.excerpt: I knew Klay was going to be a good player when I saw him in Shanghai.
quotes.quote: Three years later on his retirement tour, he told that same story against us. He said, 'I knew Klay was going to be a good player when I saw him in Shanghai in the weight room taking the game super serious. I thought I was by myself working out, but he was in there and I knew he had a bright future.' The fact that he told that story three years later, even remember that moment, that just meant the world to me because I grew up down here. I watched his whole career and he really inspired not just myself, but an entire generation. People who think 'Kobe mentality' is just a buzzword, it is a vibe.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on the significance of owning a ball signed by Bill Russell
quotes.excerpt: Bill Russell signed this ball. That is the real GOAT right there.
quotes.quote: Bill Russell signed this ball. That is the real GOAT right there, 11 rings. Bill Russell, number six from West Oakland, California, signed this and this will stay in my family forever. This is my most prized possession because not only did Bill do so much for the game, but he championed civil rights. He did so much for Black folks in this nation and he was a true pioneer of the sport. This is such a special piece of history for me. I know Stephen Curry got one, Draymond Green got one, and I just meant the world to me.

quotes.speaker: Klay Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Klay Thompson on his history of picking the Warriors in NBA 2K
quotes.excerpt: I've been riding with them since I got in the league.
quotes.quote: I retired from 2K. My brother effectively retired me because I would play 2K and I came in the league in 2012 and I am picking myself and picking the Warriors every time. And then we got so good, everyone got upset with me like, 'Why are you always picking the Dubs?' I am like, 'Because I have been riding with them since I got in the league.' And everyone was getting mad at me. I bust his ass in real life, so it is like, you know, 2K is not good for my blood pressure.
